toolDescriptions.list_servers: List servers available to this token, including identifiers, names, addresses and status. Unauthorized servers are excluded.
toolDescriptions.get_server_info: Read details of an authorized server, including address, port, username, status and operating system.
toolDescriptions.list_directory: List files and subdirectories at a remote path. Requires directory listing permission.
toolDescriptions.read_file: Read a remote text file. Oversized files are rejected and long content is truncated by line count. Requires file read permission.
toolDescriptions.write_file: Write up to 2 MiB of UTF-8 text. Requires both file read and write permissions. The original content is checked before writing; changes stop the write.
toolDescriptions.create_directory: Create a remote directory, including missing parent directories. Requires file write permission.
toolDescriptions.delete_file: Delete a remote file or directory. Directories are removed recursively. Requires explicitly granted file deletion permission.
toolDescriptions.get_system_info: Inspect CPU, memory, disks and network status. Requires monitoring permission; container statistics are included only with container read permission.
toolDescriptions.execute_command: Submit a shell command as a durable background task. Use the returned task identifier to read status and output. Never automatically retry an uncertain execution.
toolDescriptions.list_scripts: List approved scripts, exact versions and parameter constraints using cursor pagination. When more results exist, continue using the returned next-page cursor.
toolDescriptions.execute_script: Submit an approved script version as a background task. Parameters must satisfy grant rules. Use the returned task identifier to inspect status and output.
toolDescriptions.get_task: Read the status and output of tasks created by this token. Tasks created by other credentials are not accessible.
toolDescriptions.cancel_task: Request cancellation of a task created by this token. Cancellation does not roll back effects already produced on the remote server.
